_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measurements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "site" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "per100_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_servings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_log_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_meal" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meal_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "saved_meal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES saved_meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "portions" INTEGER NOT NULL, "prep_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "cook_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "storage" TEXT NULL, "freezer_friendly" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("freezer_friendly" IN (0, 1)), "reheating" TEXT NULL, "favourite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favourite" IN (0, 1)), "method_steps_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "declared_kcal" REAL NULL, "declared_protein_g" REAL NULL, "declared_carbs_g" REAL NULL, "declared_fat_g" REAL NULL, "declared_fibre_g" REAL NULL, "nutrition_note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_ingredients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "kcal" REAL NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "primary_muscle" TEXT NOT NULL, "secondary_muscles_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "split" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_weekdays_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_reps" INTEGER NULL, "target_load_kg" REAL NULL, "target_duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "set_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "load_kg" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "assistance_kg" REAL NULL, "duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "metres" REAL NULL, "average_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "exertion_scale" TEXT NULL, "exertion_value" REAL NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "site" TEXT NULL, "target" REAL NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_measurements_site_recorded ON measurements (site, recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_foods_barcode ON foods (barcode)
CREATE INDEX idx_foods_search_key ON foods (search_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_servings_food ON food_servings (food_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_log_day ON food_log_entries (day)
CREATE INDEX idx_saved_meal_items_meal ON saved_meal_items (saved_meal_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_recipe_ingredients_recipe ON recipe_ingredients (recipe_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_plan_exercises_plan ON plan_exercises (plan_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_workout_sessions_started ON workout_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_sets_session ON session_sets (session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_sets_exercise ON session_sets (exercise_id)
